protocol: One test process. Each family's requests are served from a session director of its own, closed before the next family loads, so the card holds one family at a time, the first request of each a fresh load. Each request is read under a ledger of its parts that reads the process's device high-water mark at each part's start and end; a part's peak is the most the process held while it was open, a part begun inside it included, and the whole request's the most it held during it. Krea at 1024 square on its own steps; MOSS on its own steps; Wan at its own frames, size and steps; LiveEdit on a striped clip at its source size; the autoencoder on the frame the reconstruction evaluation cuts. Answers are never served from the store.
